name: Where you were forty minutes late
story:
You blamed the metro.

I found out *two years later* there was no metro problem. I'd have waited longer.

name: The bench that decided things
story:
We sat here until it got cold and neither of us said anything about going home.

You still claim you weren't cold. You were *shaking*.

name: Meeting your parents
story:
Your father asked me three questions. Your mother asked me thirty.

I preferred *your mother's* approach.
